g.text: Message / resume segment or interrupt target.
Never resolve the latest active execution on every event.
No raw credentials or public execution identifier.
All writers share causal prerequisite checks and ordered commit.
Allocate sequence and append atomically, retaining lock to commit.
Network and model/tool work stay outside the transaction.
Implementation names and scheduling remain target-only.
Receipt first, exactly once; then matching output.
Slow clients fail independently without cancelling execution.
DTOs never cross the HTTP response boundary.
